{{Quote|Consume it.''"<br />"''I know this plant. It will poison me.''"<br />"''It will, but I will make certain you don't die.|Darth Plagueis forces Darth Venamis to ingest a coma-bloom|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
The '''coma-bloom''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]], horn-shaped [[Flower/Legends|flower]] that could be found within the artificially-created [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of exotic and rare [[Plant/Legends|plants]] on the [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] grounds of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]]. The otherwise innocuous-appearing flower blossomed on low-hanging [[Vine/Legends|vines]], from which it could be easily plucked by hand. Due to containing alkaloids that affected the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] if ingested, the coma-bloom was known to be highly [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

Shortly after the [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on Sojourn in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|dark side adept]] [[Darth Venamis]] was forced to ingest a coma-bloom after being [[Contest on Sojourn|defeated]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Aware of the plant's properties, Venamis reluctantly complied with Plagueis's orders and consumed the flower, which plunged him into a [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] state and would have [[Death/Legends|killed]] him if not for Plagueis's use of drugs to maintain his unconscious state indefinitely and carry out experiments with the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] in the Bith's [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The coma-bloom appeared in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
